Product Owner

Reality Games is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Product Owner to join our dynamic Product department. As a Product Owner, you will play a crucial role in driving the success of our innovative gaming products.

Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define product vision and strategy.
• Gather and prioritize product requirements based on market research and customer feedback.
• Create and maintain product roadmaps, ensuring alignment with business goals.
• Work closely with development teams to ensure timely and successful product delivery.
• Conduct user acceptance testing and gather feedback to continuously improve product quality.
• Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities and risks.
• Communicate product updates and releases to C-level management and Head of Production.
